primary_negative_control.procedure: Reject a bespoke route dialog: run action test + Chrome; require shared sf-dialog/data-sf-dialog-open/A3 and no dialogTriggers.
primary_negative_control.expected: Shared Phase 3B primitives and A3 layout only.

primary_negative_control.procedure: Reject separate account/card tabs: require master items, exactly one selected, hasTabs=false; select account then card.
primary_negative_control.expected: One unified master-detail list, no tabs.

primary_negative_control.procedure: Reject leaked/ambiguous context: run view-model + account identifier tests for masking and institution/type/status/currency.
primary_negative_control.expected: Masked identifiers and explicit hierarchical context.

primary_negative_control.procedure: Reject detached instruments: require instrument content/API hooks under selected card and no dedicated legacy instrument dialog.
primary_negative_control.expected: Instruments and maintenance nested in selected card.

primary_negative_control.procedure: Reject custom/navigation edit flow: run shared dialog keyboard scenario; Enter/Escape, focus inside/restored, no route change.
primary_negative_control.expected: Contextual shared create/edit dialog lifecycle passes.

primary_negative_control.procedure: Reject residual legacy pipeline: run legacy/standardization tests + Chrome; no tabs, action menus or accounts/cards post-processing.
primary_negative_control.expected: Direct-rendered route with replaced enhancements absent.

primary_negative_control.procedure: Reject desktop-only/inaccessible UI: run 1440x900,1366x768,390x844; no overflow, labelled dialog, viewport/focus checks.
primary_negative_control.expected: Responsive and keyboard/focus checks pass at all viewports.

primary_negative_control.procedure: Reject silent BRL fallback: run USD and unknown-card fixtures; payment-account USD and “Moeda indisponível”, never fallback BRL.
primary_negative_control.expected: Known currency inherited; unknown explicit unavailable.

primary_negative_control.procedure: Reject legacy/inconsistent actions: require selected-detail action/API hooks and legacyActionMenuCount=0.
Reject ambiguous instrument ownership: require instrument section/content inside data-resource-detail="card".
primary_negative_control.expected: Instrument records belong to selected card detail.

primary_negative_control.procedure: Reject unnecessary edit navigation: open/close shared edit dialog in-place and assert focus restored.

Reject happy-path-only UI: execute zero-result, delayed-save, simulated-500, rejected-fetch transport failure and long-content scenarios; the transport regression must hide loading, re-enable submit and show an actionable retry message.
primary_negative_control.expected: Empty, loading, HTTP error, transport error and long-content states remain recoverable without trapping the form.

primary_negative_control.procedure: Reject partial retirement: run standardization, legacy post-processor, SSR tests + Chrome; zero served replaced artifacts.
primary_negative_control.expected: All replaced enhancements retired/deprecated with coverage.

primary_negative_control.procedure: Reject static-only visual proof: verify workflow builds/starts app, runs registered Chrome scenarios, secret check and evidence upload.
primary_negative_control.expected: Real browser gate succeeds and publishes evidence.
